title: An F-35 fighter jet caught fire after an aircraft mishap at Marine Corps Air Station Miramar in San Diego on Friday morning (20:00 Tehran time).
text:
An F-35 fighter jet caught fire after an aircraft mishap at Marine Corps Air Station Miramar in San Diego on Friday morning (20:00 Tehran time)."

"Heavy smoke was seen around 10 a.m., and emergency crews responded to the scene."

"Officials are investigating the cause, and no additional details have been released."

"Source: FOX 5
